arxiv-1410-6146.title: Building Block Components to Control a Data Rate in the Apache Hadoop Compute Platform
arxiv-1410-6146.creator: Tien Van Do 1 , Binh T. Vu 1 , Nam H. Do 1 , Lóránt Farkas 4 , Csaba Rotter 4 , Tamás Tarjányi 4
arxiv-1410-6146.description: Abstract Resource management is one of the most indispensable components of cluster-level infrastructure layers. Users of such systems should be able to specify their job requirements as a configuration parameter (CPU, RAM, disk I/O, network I/O) and have the scheduler translate those into an appropriate reservation and allocation of resources.

arxiv-1609-02214.title: Automated Segmentation of Retinal Layers from Optical Coherent Tomography Images Using Geodesic Distance
arxiv-1609-02214.creator: Jinming Duan, Christopher Tench, Irene Gottlob, Frank Proudlock, Li Bai
arxiv-1609-02214.description: Abstract Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive imaging technique that can produce images of the eye at the microscopic level. OCT image segmentation to localise retinal layer boundaries is a fundamental procedure for diagnosing and monitoring the progression of retinal and optical nerve disorders.

arxiv-1911-05758.title: What do you mean, bert ? Assessing bert as a Distributional Semantics Model
arxiv-1911-05758.creator: Timothee Mickus, Denis Paperno, Mathieu Constant, Kees van Deemter
arxiv-1911-05758.description: Abstract Contextualized word embeddings, i.e. vector representations for words in context, are naturally seen as an extension of previous noncontextual distributional semantic models. In this work, we focus on bert , a deep neural network that produces contextualized embeddings and has set the state-of-the-art in several semantic tasks, and study the semantic coherence of its embedding space.

arxiv-2103-00713.title: Lower Bounds and Improved Algorithms for Asymmetric Streaming Edit Distance and Longest Common Subsequence
arxiv-2103-00713.creator: Xin Li, Yu Zheng
arxiv-2103-00713.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xin Li, Yu Zheng. In this paper, we study edit distance ( 𝖤𝖣 \mathsf{ED} ) and longest common subsequence ( 𝖫𝖢𝖲 \mathsf{LCS} ) in the asymmetric streaming model, introduced by Saks and Seshadhri [ SS13 ] . As an intermediate model between the random access model and the streaming model, this model allows one to have streaming access to one string and random access to the other string.

arxiv-2205-14898.title: Friction-dependent rheology of dry granular systems Journal: Acta Mech. Sin.
arxiv-2205-14898.creator: Teng Man 1∗, Pei Zhang 1∗, Zhuan Ge 1,2, Sergio A. Galindo-Torres 1, K. M. Hill 3
arxiv-2205-14898.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Teng Man 1∗, Pei Zhang 1∗, Zhuan Ge 1,2, Sergio A. Galindo-Torres 1, K. M. Hill 3. Understanding the rheology of granular assemblies is important for natural and engineering systems, but the relationship between inter-particle friction (or microscopic friction) and macroscopic friction is still not well understood.

arxiv-2208-11944.title: AutoEnRichness: A hybrid empirical and analytical approach for estimating the richness of galaxy clusters 2022 AutoEnRichness: A hybrid empirical and analytical approach for estimating the richness of galaxy clusters – References
arxiv-2208-11944.creator: Matthew C. Chan, John P. Stott E-mails: m.c.chan@lancaster.ac.uk and j.p.stott@lancaster.ac.uk
arxiv-2208-11944.description: Abstract We introduce AutoEnRichness, a hybrid approach that combines empirical and analytical strategies to determine the richness of galaxy clusters (in the redshift range of 0.1 ≤ z ≤ 0.35 0.1\leq z\leq 0.35 ) using photometry data from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey Data Release 16, where cluster richness can be used as a proxy for cluster mass.

arxiv-2402-05790.title: Underwater MEMS Gyrocompassing: A Virtual Testing Ground
arxiv-2402-05790.creator: Daniel Engelsman, Itzik Klein
arxiv-2402-05790.description: Abstract In underwater navigation, accurate heading information is crucial for accurately and continuously tracking trajectories, especially during extended missions beneath the waves. In order to determine the initial heading, a gyrocompassing procedure must be employed. As unmanned underwater vehicles (UUV) are susceptible to ocean currents and other disturbances, the model-based gyrocompassing procedure may experience degraded performance.

arxiv-2407-20909.title: Impact of Geographical Separation on Spectrum Sharing Markets
arxiv-2407-20909.creator: Kangle Mu, Zongyun Xie, Igor Kadota, and Randall Berry
arxiv-2407-20909.description: Abstract With the increasing demand for wireless services, spectrum management agencies and service providers (SPs) are seeking more flexible mechanisms for spectrum sharing to accommodate this growth. Such mechanisms impact the market dynamics of competitive SPs. Prior market models of spectrum sharing largely focus on scenarios where competing SPs had identical coverage areas.

arxiv-2410-11479.title: A new hierarchy for complex plane curves
arxiv-2410-11479.creator: Takuro Abe, Alexandru Dimca, Piotr Pokora
arxiv-2410-11479.description: Abstract . We define the type of a plane curve as the initial degree of the corresponding Bourbaki ideal. Then we show that this invariant behaves well with respect to the union of curves. Curves of type 0 0 are precisely the free curves, while curves of type 1 1 are the plus-one generated curves.

arxiv-2411-14712.title: Diffusiophoretic transport of colloids in porous media
arxiv-2411-14712.creator: Mobin Alipour, Yiran Li, Haoyu Liu, Amir A. Pahlavan
arxiv-2411-14712.description: Abstract Understanding how colloids move in crowded environments is key for gaining control over their transport in applications such as drug delivery, filtration, contaminant/microplastic remediation and agriculture. The classical models of colloid transport in porous media rely on geometric characteristics of the medium, and hydrodynamic/non-hydrodynamic equilibrium interactions to predict their behavior.

arxiv-2506-02112.title: SAB3R: Semantic-Augmented Backbone in 3D Reconstruction
arxiv-2506-02112.creator: Xuweiyi Chen, Tian Xia, Sihan Xu, Jianing Yang, Joyce Chai, Zezhou Cheng
arxiv-2506-02112.description: Abstract We introduce a new task, Map and Locate , which unifies the traditionally distinct objectives of open-vocabulary segmentation—detecting and segmenting object instances based on natural language queries—and 3D reconstruction, the process of estimating a scene’s 3D structure from visual inputs.

arxiv-2508-02107.title: AutoLoRA: Automatic LoRA Retrieval and Fine-Grained Gated Fusion for Text-to-Image Generation
arxiv-2508-02107.creator: Zhiwen Li, Zhongjie Duan, Die Chen, Cen Chen, Daoyuan Chen, Yaliang Li, Yingda Chen
arxiv-2508-02107.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhiwen Li, Zhongjie Duan, Die Chen, Cen Chen, Daoyuan Chen, Yaliang Li, Yingda Chen. Despite recent advances in photorealistic image generation through large-scale models like FLUX and Stable Diffusion v3, the practical deployment of these architectures remains constrained by their inherent intractability to parameter fine-tuning.

arxiv-2509-13513.title: Astrometric Methods for Detecting Exomoons Orbiting Imaged Exoplanets: Prospects for Detecting Moons Orbiting a Giant Planet in α \alpha Centauri A’s Habitable Zone
arxiv-2509-13513.creator: Kevin Wagner, Ewan Douglas, Steve Ertel, Kyran Grattan, S. Pete Worden, Aniket Sanghi, Billy Quarles, & Charles Beichman
arxiv-2509-13513.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kevin Wagner, Ewan Douglas, Steve Ertel, Kyran Grattan, S. Pete Worden, Aniket Sanghi, Billy Quarles, & Charles Beichman. Nearby giant exoplanets offer an opportunity to search for moons (exomoons) orbiting them. Here, we present a simulation framework for investigating the possibilities of detecting exomoons via their astrometric signal in planet-to-star relative astrometry. We focus our simulations on α \alpha Centauri A, orbited by a hypothetical giant planet consistent with candidate detections in Very Large Telescope and James Webb Space Telescope observations.

arxiv-2602-15313.title: Mnemis: Dual-Route Retrieval on Hierarchical Graphs for Long-Term LLM Memory
arxiv-2602-15313.creator: Zihao Tang, Xin Yu*, Ziyu Xiao, Zengxuan Wen, Zelin Li, Jiaxi Zhou, Hualei Wang, Haohua Wang, Haizhen Huang, Denvy Deng, Feng Sun, Qi Zhang Microsoft ⋆ Corresponding Author
arxiv-2602-15313.description: Abstract AI Memory, specifically how models organizes and retrieves historical messages, becomes increasingly valuable to Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing methods (RAG and Graph-RAG) primarily retrieve memory through similarity-based mechanisms. While efficient, such System-1-style retrieval struggles with scenarios that require global reasoning or comprehensive coverage of all relevant information.

pmc-10573930.title: Transcatheter Closure of Perimembranous Ventricular Septal Defects Including Multifenestrated and Gerbode-Type Defects Using the Lifetech Konar Device
pmc-10573930.creator: Francois Godart, Jean Benoit Baudelet, Alexandre Delarue, Anne Sophie Polge, Olivia Domanski, Said Bichali, Ali Houeijeh, Alexander H Maass
pmc-10573930.description: (1) Transcatheter closure of perimembranous ventricular septal defects (PmVSD) is becoming more attractive and effective with the development of new occluders. The aim of this study was to report a single-center experience in PmVSD closure using the Lifetech Konar-multifunctional occluder (MFO). (2) From March 2019 to October 2022, 43 consecutive patients were enrolled in the study.

pmc-10699737.title: Molar Pregnancy–Induced Hyperthyroidism: The Importance of Early Recognition and Timely Preoperative Management
pmc-10699737.creator: Laurel Walfish, Nisha Gupta, Dong Bach Nguyen, Mark Sherman
pmc-10699737.description: Hyperthyroidism due to gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) is a rare but potentially life-threatening condition. Optimal perioperative management is crucial for favorable outcomes and prevention of thyroid storm. However, scarce data exist defining the ideal approach to this complex clinical presentation.

pmc-11384254.title: Clinical effects of non-pharmaceutical interventions for COVID-19 on other nationally notifiable infectious diseases in South Korea
pmc-11384254.creator: Hyun-Jin Lee, Beom Seuk Hwang, Seong Ho Im, Seog-Kyun Mun, Munyoung Chang
pmc-11384254.description: Background/AimsThis study aimed to assess the impact of non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic on nationally notifiable infectious diseases (NNIDs) in South Korea.MethodsLong-term data on seven NNIDs from 2018 to 2021 were analyzed to identify trends and change points using a change point detection technique.

pmc-11476548.title: Role of mast cells in the pathogenesis of oral submucous fibrosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11476548.creator: Laliytha Kumar Bijai, Ali A Aboalela, Farraj Albalawi, Sanjeev B Khanagar, Kiran Iyer
pmc-11476548.description: BackgroundOral Submucous Fibrosis (OSMF) is an oral potentially malignant disorder (OPMD) that commonly occurs in the South Asian population as there is high usage of areca nut. There has been extensive research on the pathogenesis and treatment of this condition. It is well-established in the scientific literature that mast cells (MC) have a definitive role in several inflammatory disorders.

pmc-11506085.title: Reactive Oxygen and Nitrogen Species in Plants
pmc-11506085.creator: Francisco J Corpas, José M. Palma
pmc-11506085.description: plays a crucial role in the response mechanisms to both abiotic and biotic environmental stresses [5]. These molecules are particularly significant because, at low concentrations, some of them possess signaling properties [6,7]. However, when ROS and RNS are overproduced and not properly regulated, they can induce nitro-oxidative stress, which may ultimately lead to cell death.

pmc-11728520.title: Antivenom Administration After Rattlesnake Envenoming in Arizona Does Not Directly Diminish Pain
pmc-11728520.creator: Vance G Nielsen, Darien L Stratton, Tyler M Hoelscher, Hannah L Nakamura, Matthew M Cornelison, William F Rushton, Geoffrey T Smelski
pmc-11728520.description: The onset, progression, and severity of pain following rattlesnake envenomation are highly variable between patients. Pain can be severe and persistent, seemingly refractory to opioid analgesics. The ability of antivenom to directly relieve pain has not been well studied. We reviewed poison center charts of rattlesnake envenomations between 1 January 2018, and 31 December 2022.

pmc-12540835.title: CENP-E initiates chromosome congression by opposing Aurora kinases to promote end-on attachments
pmc-12540835.creator: Kruno Vukušić, Iva M Tolić
pmc-12540835.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Accurate cell division relies on rapid chromosome congression. The kinetochore motor protein CENP-E/kinesin-7 is uniquely required for congression of polar chromosomes. It is currently assumed that CENP-E drives congression by gliding kinetochores along microtubules independently of their biorientation. Here, by studying chromosome movement under different levels of CENP-E activity, we favor an alternative model in which CENP-E initiates congression by promoting stabilization of end-on attachments. In this way, CENP-E accelerates congression initiation without significantly contributing to subsequent movement.

pmc-12651793.title: Physiologically Relevant Simulation of Carbohydrate Digestion: From Glycemic Index Estimation to Intestinal Cellular Responses
pmc-12651793.creator: Jinfeng Meng, Ying Sun, Peng Wu, Zhizhong Dong, Yuhan Qin, Liming Wang, Jie Xiao, Can Hou, Xin Ying, Jiaxing Gao, Meili Huan, Ran Chen, Yan Wang, Yufeng Wang, Jingjing Wang, Xiaodong Chen, Tai An
pmc-12651793.description: Simulating carbohydrate digestion in physiologically relevant ways remains a challenge for in vitro models. In this study, the Dynamic In vitro Human Stomach (DIVHS) system was applied to investigate cereal digestion and subsequent intestinal cellular responses. Rice, millet, and corn were digested under dynamic and static conditions.

pmc-12747555.title: High‐throughput generic single‐entity sequencing using droplet microfluidics
pmc-12747555.creator: Guoping Wang, Liuyang Zhao, Yu Shi, Fuyang Qu, Yanqiang Ding, Weixin Liu, Changan Liu, Gang Luo, Meiyi Li, Xiaowu Bai, Luoquan Li, Luyao Wang, Chi Chun Wong, Yi‐Ping Ho, Jun Yu
pmc-12747555.description: Single‐cell sequencing has revolutionized our understanding of cellular heterogeneity by providing a micro‐level perspective in the past decade. While heterogeneity is fundamental to diverse biological communities, existing platforms are primarily designed for eukaryotic cells, leaving significant gaps in the study of other single biological entities, such as viruses and bacteria.

pmc-13236724.title: Mitogenome characteristics of two Tetragonula stingless bees (Hymenoptera: Apidae) from Hainan, China
pmc-13236724.creator: Shi-Jie Wang, Jiao Wu, Xi-Zhe Yang, Min Zhao, Cheng-Ye Wang
pmc-13236724.description: The complete mitochondrial genomes (mitogenomes) of two ecologically important stingless bees, Tetragonula gressitti (Sakagami) and T. laeviceps (Smith), were sequenced and analyzed. Both species display the typical insect mitogenome structures but exhibit species-specific structural rearrangements and sequence variation. Their mitogenomes are AT-rich (81.5% and 75.2%, respectively), significantly influencing codon usage patterns.

pmc-13388380.title: Neuromuscular characteristics of dynamic balance control in patients with sarcopenia: a combined analysis of surface electromyography and limits of stability
pmc-13388380.creator: Jingchun Wang, Ting Zhang, Qian Qian, Wenpeng Shan, Jie Xiang
pmc-13388380.description: IntroductionSarcopenia is a major risk factor for falls in older adults; however, the neuromuscular characteristics underlying dynamic balance deficits remain poorly understood.ObjectiveThis study aimed to investigate balance performance and relative muscle contribution patterns in older adults with sarcopenia during dynamic limits of stability (LOS) tasks.MethodsTwenty-seven right-dominant older adults with sarcopenia and 27 age-matched non-sarcopenic controls were recruited.

pmc-13478445.title: Modeling treatment effects on absorbing outcomes in clinical trials: Leveraging longitudinal and ordinal data for efficiency gains
pmc-13478445.creator: Chiara Di Gravio, Ran Tao, Yunbi Nam, Eric P Schmidt, Nathan Shapiro, Jonathan S Schildcrout
pmc-13478445.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Randomized clinical trials in critically ill populations often use mortality at the end of follow-up as the primary outcome. When mortality is rare, composite outcomes that capture disease severity over time are frequently employed to improve efficiency. Motivated by the Crystalloid Liberal or Vasopressor Early Resuscitation in Sepsis (CLOVERS) trial—a randomized study comparing two fluid resuscitation strategies in hospitalized patients with sepsis—we evaluate multiple modeling approaches for estimating covariate-adjusted treatment effects on absorbing outcomes such as mortality.

pmc-13633983.title: Moral distress: sometimes, there is no fix
pmc-13633983.creator: Cullin Brown, Jan Helge Solbakk
pmc-13633983.description: Since Andrew Jameton introduced the term “moral distress” (MD) in 1984, the idea has gained enormous attention in the healthcare literature. We offer a critical, narrative review of the understandings of MD that have been proposed, with an eye towards their scope and corresponding ability to speak to the moral vulnerability inherent in human life.

uslaw-usc-t33-s497.title: 33 U.S.C. § 497 — “Persons” defined
uslaw-usc-t33-s497.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s497.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 11 (Bridges Over Navigable Waters); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The word “persons” as used in sections 491 to 494 and 495 to 498 of this title, shall be construed to import both the singular and the plural, as the case demands, and shall include municipalities, quasi-municipal corporations.
